standard.description: Analyst → executor → reviewer in a dedicated worktree. Default for code changes in git repositories.

pair.description: Executor + reviewer for small, already well-specified tasks.

abap.description: ABAP work: the SAP system is read-only through MCP, the owner transfers code and creates transports. No git worktree unless the repo uses abapGit.

members.name: analyst
members.instructions: Use the read-only SAP MCP servers to study the objects involved. List every ABAP object (type + name) the change touches. Parallel teams must not touch the same objects.

members.name: executor
members.instructions: The SAP system is read-only for you. Deliver the complete source of every changed or new ABAP object as `code` artifacts (one per object, named like zcl_foo.clas.abap), plus a short transfer guide (order of objects, activation notes). With abapGit repos, commit the files instead.

members.name: reviewer
members.instructions: Review the ABAP code artifacts against clean ABAP guidelines and the current system state (read via MCP): syntax plausibility, naming, performance (SELECT in loops, buffering), authorisation checks, and that only agreed objects change.

spike.description: Research without code changes on a ready task: analyst investigates, reviewer challenges the conclusions.

research.description: Refinement team for an unresearched task: analysts investigate and propose scope + acceptance criteria; a reviewer challenges them. Allowed before the task is ready.

full.description: Larger code change: analyst, executor, tester and reviewer, documenter joins after approval.
